# IT Infrastructure Monitoring and Optimization Plan 2026

This document outlines key tasks for IT infrastructure management and security for the 2026 strategy:

*   Monitor firewall settings quarterly.
*   Monitor firewall settings specifically for strategy 2026.
*   Review firewall settings for standard updates.
*   Optimize encryption standards for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize API latency for strategy 2026.
